text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: spike in 429s from hosted inference cluster us-west-2. error-rate 12% over 5m, p50 latency normal. paging oncall.
Alex: seeing it in Prod dashboards, a few keys with very high QPS causing throttles. Not platform-wide yet but trending.
Sanjay: are these new customers or a known spike pattern? any deploys in last 30m?
Alex: no deploys. traffic from a handful of API keys (high QPS) plus steady background. looks like prefix caching miss rate jumped.
Maria: I'm starting emergency traffic shaping: will reduce per-key soft limit to 30r/s and enable short-term request queueing at the edge. That should flatten bursts without dropping tokens.
Kevin: I can do a temporary quota bump for a couple of enterprise customers who are impacted. Which keys?
Alex: keys: cust-42-prod, cust-88-prod. Both reporting 5xx->429 cascades. Please only bump if CS confirms they are impacted (don't auto-bump all).
Olivia: for client-side mitigation we should push guidance ASAP. Recommend SDK change: switch to exponential backoff with full jitter, cap attempts to 5, and require idempotency token header `Idempotency-Key` for non-idempotent requests. Example snippet:

```
# pseudocode for SDK retry wrapper
retry(attempt=0, max=5):
  wait = random_between(0, base * 2**attempt)
  sleep(wait)
  resp = call_api()
  if resp.status in [429, 503] and attempt < max:
    attempt += 1
    goto retry
  return resp

# attach idempotency for repeatable ops
headers["Idempotency-Key"] = uuid4()
```

Olivia: Also add `Retry-After` respect and backoff multiplier of 1.5 for 429s that include it.
Sanjay: good. Can we publish a one-paragraph note in the SDK repo and patch the mobile SDKs quickly? I can own the repo PR.
Alex: please also include idempotency guidance for streaming endpoints — suggest client send `session-id` and server do dedupe of initial token creation. Avoid automatic replays of streaming start.
Kevin: I gave cust-42-prod a +2x quota for 20 minutes (manual ticket: internal-3421). Cust-88 still at baseline pending CS verification.
deploy-bot: ACTION: applied edge soft-limit 30r/s -> 15s queue at us-west-2 (change-id: C-1951). Observability will reflect in 1m.
Maria: applying a temporary model-variant fallback policy for high-latency requests — route to quantized-smaller when p95 > 2s to reduce cost and keep throughput.
Alex: customer-impact summary for pager: ~6 customers saw increased 429s, primary affected are cust-42 and cust-88. CS contacted cust-42; they accepted temporary quota. No data loss reports.
Olivia: SDK PR draft: include code example for idempotency header and the exponential jitter function. Also add a short FAQ: "When to reduce concurrency vs when to backoff".
Sanjay: I'm taking over oncall for the next 2 hours to monitor. Alex handing off: please DM me any follow-ups. I will coordinate with CS for cust-88.
Alex: handing off to @Sanjay — I'm offsite but reachable if escalations.
oncall-bot: NOTE: incident state -> mitigation in-progress. continue monitoring. alerts downgraded to warning threshold.
Maria: p50 429 rate down to 3% after 2m, p95 latency improved. keeping shaping in place for 30m, then gradual relax.
Kevin: made a follow-up note: if customer wants uninterrupted throughput, they must request Dedicated or Reserved capacity. I'll attach cost/commit options in the CS ticket.
Sanjay: will post the SDK advisory link and the PR in #devex once merged. any other mitigation requests?
Alex: none from me. thanks team :thumbsup:
